احتقبوا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَقَبُوا (iḥtaqabū) /iħ.ta.qa.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
# اُحْتُقِبُوا (uḥtuqibū) /uħ.tu.qi.buː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
# اِحْتَقِبُوا (iḥtaqibū) /iħ.ta.qi.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
